name: AtLockTime
where: Locking tab, after On battery power: one list for what happens when the lock time comes (Lock the PC, Lock and turn off the screen, Lock and sleep, Don't lock)

name: AtLockTimeDetail
en: Away actions like muting run either way
ar: تعمل إجراءات المغادرة، مثل كتم الصوت، حتى إذا لم يُقفل الكمبيوتر
where: Locking tab, the line under At the lock time: the away actions run whether or not the PC locks

name: DontLock
where: At the lock time list, the last choice: the PC doesn't lock at the lock time, and the away actions still run
